question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The magician performed a __magnificant__ trick.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"magnificant"** is incorrect. The correct spelling is **"magnificent"**, which means extremely beautiful, elaborate, or impressive. (महान, भव्य)

 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** भव्य, शानदार
 
• **English Example:** The Taj Mahal is a magnificent piece of architecture admired around the world.
 
 
 
• The correct spelling **"magnificent"** is derived from the Latin word "magnificus," meaning "great" or "splendid."
 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** शानदार
 
• **Example:** The view from the mountain was truly magnificent.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
